title: membrane-heart
description: SYNTHETIC toy (classical software, not a medical model): a heart-shaped network of simulated neurons carries a travelling phase wave; snapshots are stored in a complex outer-product associative memory and a calibrated gate names or refuses a probe. Includes pre-registered, seeded studies with confidence intervals, including null and negative results. Not a medical device, not a diagnosis; nothing transfers to real physiology.
notes: Synthetic toy simulation. Not a medical model. Deposit metadata only; no release has been approved or made.
